context.problemStatement: Show four eighths as half of a whole.
context.groundingProse: Divide one bar into eight equal pieces, shade four pieces. Four eighths equals one half.

content.altText: A fraction bar divided into 8 equal parts with 4 parts shaded to show four eighths.

labels.description: The numerator shows how many equal parts we are looking at.
The denominator shows the total number of equal parts in the whole.

annotations.steps: I divided the fraction bar into eight equal parts and shaded four of those parts to represent four eighths.
annotations.strategy: I notice that shading four out of the eight parts covers exactly half of the entire bar, which helps me visualize equivalent fractions.
annotations.misconceptions: A common mistake is thinking that changing the denominator changes the size of the whole, rather than focusing on the relative size of the parts.
annotations.connections: This connects to simplifying fractions and finding equivalent values by scaling both the numerator and denominator by the same factor.
